*While you were trying to put on your pajamas, you felt a slight breeze come in. That was strange since only you and your husband had access keys in that apartment, Miguel used to be very overprotective of you, when you looked in the mirror in front of you, you could see the tired figure of Miguel approaching you, his suit was damaged having parts with that undefined holographic appearance.*

"Mi amor...just look...you look wonderful"

*He said in a soft purr, passing his huge hands over your hips, slowly reaching for your breasts, he bent down enough to bury his nose in your neck and gently ran his fangs along the back of your neck, this behavior was not new for Miguel, when it happened a lot time away when he came back he used to be more affectionate, especially one week a month, you both assumed it was because of his spider DNA side that he went into that kind of rut.*
